name: @zakkster/lite-adaptive
author: Zahary Shinikchiev <shinikchiev@yahoo.com>
description: Zero-dependency, zero-GC family of APPROXIMATE, sublinear-space streaming summaries over the TIME / RECENCY axis that witnesses its RECENCY against the paper's theoretical bound: ExponentialHistogram (sliding-window count / sum) + ADWIN (concept-drift detection + adaptive windowing) + ForwardDecay (time-decayed count / sum / mean / rate) + HeavyKeeper (decayed top-k / heavy hitters) + SlidingHyperLogLog (windowed distinct-count) + DriftDetector (scalar Page-Hinkley / CUSUM change detection) + SlidingDDSketch (windowed relative-error quantiles) + SlidingCountMin (windowed per-label frequency) + DecayedReservoir (recency-biased fixed-k sample) over a preallocated fixed bucket pool; the time-windowed members expose advance() / advanceFrom() so an IDLE stream still slides its window to empty with no traffic. Tree-shakeable named exports.

scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:types && npm run torture && npm run witness && npm run test:perf
